Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them. Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products. In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done. Why this role exists  Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack. The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck. They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships. The role  This position is equal parts: AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong.  On the AI side:  Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill. On the design and development side:  The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, GitHub, and AI-assisted coding workflows. The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance. Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate. What the role includes  Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency  What our client is looking for  Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using GitHub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset  What they DO NOT want  Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt  Portfolio required  Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application. Their team would like to see: At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow  What it’s like working with them  They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence. There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time. If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

title: Business Information Security Officer
description:
Empresa está contratando Business Information Security Officer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves. Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.g., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Key Deliverables Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs) Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders Core Competencies Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language Strong coordination Equality & Opportunity for All  Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws   At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.   Why Choose HCLTech?  Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint Collaborate with diverse teams across borders Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Especialista em Governança de Dados
description:

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros. Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos! Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio. Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura. Responsabilidades  Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema.  Requisitos e Qualificações  Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis.  Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial):  Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas.  Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:  PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!   Assistência Médica e Odontológica : Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família.   Vale Refeição : Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia!  ️ Seguro de Vida : Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos.

Overview  Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice. We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process. This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates  and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations. If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you. About the Role  This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches. This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process. There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics. Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft. Candidate Sourcing and Outreach  Proactively identify and engage passive candidates  through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets Prioritize phone-based outreach  as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting  Candidate Qualification and Assessment  Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers  Pipeline Management and Execution  Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems  Client and Team Collaboration  Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends  Performance Expectations  Maintain consistent daily call volume  with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations  Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members  What You’ll Bring  Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates Strong organization and time management skills Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems Professional home office setup suitable for business calls Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)  What Separates Top Recruiters  You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional  Ideal Background  Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations  Compensation and Logistics  Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission Full-time remote position Central Time schedule title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Theta Data  Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape. We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously. The Role  We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too! What You'll Do  Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps  What We're Looking For  Required  Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems Weekend support rotation  Nice to Have  Prior experience with financial data APIs Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation  Why Theta Data  Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

Role Overview  As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities  1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)  Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.  2. Script-to-Audio Alignment  Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.  3. Technical & Creative Accuracy  Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble  4. Vendor & Artist Coordination  Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.  Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.  5. QC Documentation & Tracking  Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.  6. Pre-Release Quality Checks  Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.  7. Cross-Team Collaboration  Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.  8. Process Improvement  Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology  9. Volume & Deadline Management  Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content  within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.  10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement  Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery  Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications  Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.  Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Role Overview:  We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Desired Skills and Qualifications:  Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics. Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work. Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory. Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.  More details on required skills:  Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage: Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic  Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.  Algebra and Number Theory  Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.  Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory  Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.  Topology and Geometry  Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.  Analysis  Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.  Probability and Statistics  Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.  Applied Mathematics  Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.  Offer Details:  Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor  Evaluation Process:  Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.  After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.  Know amazing talent? title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Zaigo builds AI software for real businesses.Not demos. Not slide decks. Actual tools that people use to run parts of their company.Our clients are usually owner-led or mid-market companies in the US: professional services firms, distributors, manufacturers, healthcare operators, finance teams. They have messy workflows, old systems, weird data, and very little patience for theory. We figure out what should exist, then we build it.We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who already builds heavily with AI. Someone who can take a vague client problem, turn it into a product plan, build the thing, polish it, ship it, and keep moving.If you need perfect specs, this probably is not the job. If you like owning the whole problem and moving faster than normal teams think is reasonable, it might be.What the work looks likeYou will own client projects end to end.That means you may be on a call with a business owner in the morning, designing the workflow after lunch, and shipping the first usable version that week. The work is full-stack product engineering: database, backend, UI, auth, integrations, AI agents, evals, error handling, deployment, and the judgment to know what should not be handled by a model.Recent Zaigo-style projects include:a document review tool that checks presentations against a firm's brand and compliance rulesa benchmarking platform built from years of public company filingspayroll and operations tools that clean messy data and produce files people can actually useinternal AI agents that help teams move faster without giving the model dangerous autonomyYou do not need to be an ML researcher. You do need to be a very strong engineer who knows how to use AI tools to ship better and faster.Who we are looking forYou are probably a fit if this sounds like you:You have 5+ years building software professionally.You can ship across the stack: frontend, backend, database, integrations, deployment.You use AI coding tools every day, not as a novelty. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, agents, worktrees, parallel terminals, your own setup. We care less about the exact tools and more about whether you have real opinions from using them.You think like a product owner. You ask what the user is trying to do, what the first useful version should be, and what will make people trust the system.You can work with ambiguity. Clients rarely hand you perfect requirements.You have taste. There is no reason to ship ugly software anymore.You communicate clearly in English and can talk through tradeoffs with US clients.You have high initiative. You fix things nobody assigned. You build outside work because you like building.Bonus points if you have founded something, freelanced, run a small agency, built your own product, or worked directly with clients.Who should not applyThis is probably not the right role if you want a narrow lane, a long roadmap, and fully written tickets.It is also probably not right if your AI experience is mostly prompting ChatGPT, building toy demos, or talking about agents without shipping production software.We need builders. Smart, fast, practical builders.ProcessShort application.10-minute async voice interview.Live interview with Zaigo's founder.Short practical build project.Offer if it is a fit.We move quickly. If there is a fit, you will hear from us within days, not weeks.

Job Responsibilities: Job Title: Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst  Introduction:  We are seeking an experienced Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst  to join our team and play a critical role in supporting the business across a broad spectrum of global import and export compliance matters. This position is vital in ensuring our compliance with international trade regulations while enabling data-driven decision-making through the creation of innovative dashboards and reports. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in global trade compliance and advanced analytics tools to model the potential impact of tariffs on the business model and drive continuous improvement in compliance processes. Roles and Responsibilities:  Collaborate with regional trade compliance teams and business stakeholders to gather, document, and refine business requirements and functional processes, adapting them as business needs evolve. Maintain and oversee day-to-day global classification processes to support global import volumes, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Assist with technology, hardware, and software trade classification, including management of Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) , Schedule B , and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)  classifications. Manage compliance activities equally focused on imports and exports (50% each). Develop and contribute to documented classification justifications based on the General Rules of Interpretation (GRI)  foundation for global import classifications. Provide import compliance guidance in adherence to US and international regulations, including conducting research, updating status reports, and coordinating deliverables within the team. Build, maintain, and analyze data-informed metrics to generate actionable insights that enhance the global trade compliance program. Establish and nurture positive business relationships with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams. Engage with software development teams to understand and influence evolving compliance technology, identifying opportunities to automate manual processes. Generate and contribute to performance requirements, timelines, and metrics for all related activities. Support project management efforts to ensure timely delivery of team assignments and objectives.  Qualifications:  Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within supply chain, logistics, or global trade compliance environments. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)  and detailed reports. Proven experience with global trade compliance regulations, including import/export laws and logistics preferred. Demonstrated ability to independently research and dive deep into complex compliance requests and issues.  Tools and Technologies:  Proficient in Smartsheet , Power BI , and AWS Quicksight  with hands-on experience creating new dashboards, running data batches, and developing meaningful metrics and reports. Strong data analytics and data entry skills to support compliance reporting and insights generation. Familiarity with trade classification tools and regulatory databases is a plus.  Skills:  Global trade compliance, Smartsheet, Power BI, AWS Quicksight

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Lead Product Designer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores, distribuidores, consultores e equipes de procurement no Brasil. Domínio do português. A capacidade de se comunicar em inglês será considerada uma vantagem. Preferido Experiência com projetos de hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, hospitais, escolas ou edifícios comerciais Experiência com HVAC comercial, lavanderia comercial, cozinha comercial, refrigeração, iluminação ou displays comerciais Conhecimento de instalação, manutenção, seleção técnica ou operação de equipamentos comerciais Experiência em acompanhamento de RFQ, coordenação de cotações, suporte a projetos ou desenvolvimento de oportunidades comerciais Recursos de clientes, instaladores, distribuidores ou fornecedores no Brasil  5. As principais áreas de trabalho incluem: Comunicação com clientes Acompanhamento de oportunidades de projetos Coordenação de RFQ e cotações Seleção de equipamentos comerciais Comparação de soluções e fornecedores Comunicação técnica e comercial Feedback do mercado local Apoio ao avanço dos projetos  Este cargo é especialmente adequado para profissionais com experiência ou acesso a projetos comerciais, hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, HVAC, cozinha comercial, iluminação, displays comerciais, distribuidores ou instaladores no Brasil. 6. Os detalhes podem ser discutidos durante o processo de entrevista, de acordo com a experiência, os recursos locais, a compreensão técnica e a capacidade de acompanhamento de projetos do candidato. 7. Como se candidatar  Candidate-se com uma breve apresentação destacando sua experiência em: Equipamentos comerciais HVAC ou ar-condicionado comercial Lavanderia comercial Aquecedores de água comerciais Cozinha comercial Iluminação comercial Displays comerciais Hotéis, restaurantes ou supermercados Gestão de projetos B2B Coordenação de RFQ e cotações Mercado brasileiro de equipamentos comerciais  Você também pode enviar seu CV atualizado para:  com o assunto: Application: Project Manager – Commercial Appliances, Brazil

This is a unique opportunity to participate and make a real difference in a company actively working to shape the future of AI applications for consumers. About the Role  We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Full Stack Developer to join our team. The candidate will have the mission of bringing his expertise and contribution in the rapid growth of one of our current star products. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining both the front-end and back-end of our web applications, while working in a very tight group of collaborators in a growth hacking mode, constantly integrating new cutting edge AI technologies in the context of a high volume traffic web application. This role requires a strong understanding of the entire development process, including design, development, and deployment, and a commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and the creation of quality products. What the ideal candidate will have:  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer. Availability to work with North American hours Strong experience in building user interfaces and backend services using Typescript/React/Next.js. Deep understanding of TypeScript, typing patterns, interfaces, generics, and strict type safety. Experience building REST APIs and/or Route Handlers / Server Actions in Next.js. Experience building React based frontend component with Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or other styling systems. Thorough understanding of PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization). Experience with third-party API integrations (webhooks, auth etc.). Experience deploying Next.js apps on Vercel, AWS, or other cloud providers. Familiarity with logging/monitoring tools (Sentry, Datadog, CloudWatch). Understanding of version control systems, such as Git. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to a non-technical audience. Self-motivated and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a distributed team. Strong sense of ownership and urgency, with a commitment to delivering high-quality, polished products. Proven ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and a commitment to continuous learning. Creative and analytical mindset for tackling complex technical challenges and driving innovative solutions.  Key Responsibilities  Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure web applications from end-to-end. Implement user interface and user experience (UI/UX) designs using front-end technologies. Develop and manage back-end services and APIs (Application Programming Interfaces). Integrate front-end components with back-end logic. Write clean, well-documented, and efficient code. Perform testing and debugging to ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application. Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver new features. Maintain code integrity and organization, and participate in code reviews. Stay up-to-date with new technologies and industry best practices.  Why Join Us?  You love building real, meaningful features—not just completing tickets You want autonomy and real ownership. You enjoy solving problems across frontend, backend, and database. You thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment. You care about clean code and great user experience. We offer Unlimited Vacations Policy. You want a Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to \"once per week\"). You want Flex-time and Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results). You want an opportunity to work closely with leadership and gain cross-functional experience in a fast-growing company at the forefront of the AI revolution.  If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team in the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!
